newsitem.title: ITALY: Italians seize cocaine, arrest seven in drugs op.
newsitem.headline: Italians seize cocaine, arrest seven in drugs op.

text.p: Police on Friday said they had seized 200 kilos (440 lbs) of cocaine and arrested seven Italians after an operation involving investigators in Italy, Colombia and the United States.
Police in Florence told a news conference that the drug had been brought into Italy by ship hidden in boxes of dried flowers.
Police allowed the drug, shipped from the Colombian port of Cartagena to Livorno, to be collected before making the arrests.

The four-month operation, codenamed Nicaragua, also led to the arrest of three Colombians in the United States and the seizure of 366 kilos (805 lbs) of cocaine in the state of New Jersey, police said.
